invariant_text: All six distributions co-install without namespace or third-party collisions.
tool: tools/run_package_install_proof.py --format nrrd --format ora --format xliff --format ipynb --format safetensors --format ubl
result_summary: 6/6 PASS -- the first time all six FF6 formats have been built as wheels and installed together into one shared ephemeral venv.
blocker_that_previously_prevented_this_c: ora (OpenRaster) had no entry in packaging/python/package-matrix.yaml at all before this tick -- every prior compatibility-gate run (ipynb, safetensors, xliff) could only prove a 5-format co-install (nrrd+xliff+ipynb+safetensors+ubl), explicitly excluding ora and explicitly flagging this as 'a separate, pre-existing finding' in each of those gate files. Added a matrix entry for ora (format_factory.ora, load() smoke test against samples/by-format/ora/valid/minimal.ora, matching the exact schema every other format_factory.* entry already uses) -- verified with a solo `--format ora` proof (1/1 PASS) before attempting the full 6-format run.

failing_modules.ubl._build_backend: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'setuptools' -- build-time-only module not installed in the runtime proof venv by design, not a collision
failing_modules.ubl.ubl_to_csv: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'ff_csv' -- a separate, optional cross-product export package not part of this scoped 6-format set, not a collision

collision_check: PASS -- zero namespace collisions (every format lives under its own format_factory.{format_id} package, or a top-level {format_id} module for the non-namespace-packaged formats) and zero third-party dependency version conflicts across all 6 packages' own declared dependencies (installed together into one shared site-packages without any resolver error or forced downgrade). The only 2 import failures anywhere in the run (both ubl's own) are pre-existing, already-documented in ipynb/safetensors/xliff's own compatibility-gate.json files, and are unrelated to cross-package collision -- confirmed by their own error messages (a missing build-time dependency and a missing separate optional package, neither caused by another FF6 format being co-installed).
note: This satisfies exactly ONE of product-goal.yaml's own multiple completion_invariants -- it is not a certification claim for any format, and it does not by itself satisfy the OTHER outstanding program-wide invariant ('every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests', still untouched for all six formats per this session's own Event 315 self-correction). No promotion.* field in controller-state.yaml changes as a result of this gate alone.
